## Standing operator rules
Never create or modify a Stripe webhook without placing the ADR link in #billing-integrations and tagging @priya. Every change to deploy/.env.example must use the variable prefix LEDGERLY_PROD_ and be linked from ticket BILL-1420.

## Current objective
Add a CSV vendor-credit importer at `ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py` for finance this week. SQLAlchemy 1.4→2.0 is paused, not superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Sandbox payments: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is shut down and returns stale fixtures, so it is superseded. Kafka: `kafka-01:9092`, group/topic `orders-v1`/`orders.v1`; `orders.v2` has 12 partitions. Importer path: `ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Disabling idempotency middleware caused duplicate staging invoices.

## Plan and progress
Kafka steps 1–3 are done: stopped and described `orders-v1`; offsets are in `/var/tmp/orders-v1-offsets.txt`. `orders.v2` creation is done. CSV import is pending; no command issued, so status is unknown.

## Recent work
Added and verified `tests/test_currency_rounding.py`; full suite passed 184 tests, 2 skipped, with Ruff clean. Inspected `billing_worker.py`; `process_batch()` leaves completed `self.pending_events` items queued.

[Operator messages from earlier in this session, kept verbatim]
Operator: Never create or modify a Stripe webhook without placing the ADR link in #billing-integrations and tagging @priya.
Operator: Goal for this session: upgrade SQLAlchemy from 1.4 to 2.0 across the ledgerly models.
Operator: separate from the main session goal, please also run the procedure 'Kafka repartition offset migration' in between your other work. Goal: Safely migrate orders.v1 from six partitions to orders.v2 with twelve partitions, replay records, and switch the orders-v1 consumer group to the new topic. Run these steps in order, one at a time:
1. Check source topic: `kafka-topics --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --describe --topic orders.v1`
2. Stop old consumers: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --group orders-v1 --stop`
3. Export committed offsets: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --group orders-v1 --describe --offsets > /var/tmp/orders-v1-offsets.txt`
4. Create destination topic: `kafka-topics --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --create --if-not-exists --topic orders.v2 --partitions 12 --replication-factor 3`
5. Submit partition reassignment: `printf '%s\n' '{"version":1,"partitions":[{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":0,"replicas":[1,2,3]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":1,"replicas":[2,3,1]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":2,"replicas":[3,1,2]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":3,"replicas":[1,2,3]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":4,"replicas":[2,3,1]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":5,"replicas":[3,1,2]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":6,"replicas":[1,2,3]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":7,"replicas":[2,3,1]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":8,"replicas":[3,1,2]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":9,"replicas":[1,2,3]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":10,"replicas":[2,3,1]},{"topic":"orders.v2","partition":11,"replicas":[3,1,2]}]}' > /var/tmp/orders-v2-reassign.json`
6. Apply reassignment: `kafka-reassign-partitions --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --execute --reassignment-json-file /var/tmp/orders-v2-reassign.json`
7. Replay source records: `kafka-console-consumer --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --topic orders.v1 --from-beginning --max-messages 200000 | kafka-console-producer --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --topic orders.v2`
8. Initialize new offsets: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-01:9092 --group orders-v2 --topic orders.v2:0-11 --reset-offsets --to-offset 0 --execute`
9. Switch application configuration: `sed -i.bak 's/orders\.v1/orders.v2/g; s/group.id=orders-v1/group.id=orders-v2/g' /etc/orders-consumer/application.properties`
